shared_elements: flat vertical stone slab carved in low relief
composition divided into horizontal registers by incised lines/bands
an upper band of repeated motifs running across the top
profile figures facing inward toward a central axis
paired figures flanking a central element
curved/arched forms spanning the top of the field
quadruped/standing anthropomorphic figures with visible limbs
undecorated lower zone at the base
justification: Both are upright stone slabs whose surfaces are divided by horizontal incised lines into stacked registers, with an arched or repeated motif band across the top and a main field containing profile figures disposed either side of a central axis, plus a plain zone at the bottom. The rendering differs sharply, however: A is a deep, coarse, boldly modelled relief of animals with no sign-like elements, while B is a shallow, controlled, fine-lined relief of human figures accompanied by dense small script-like symbols, so the resemblance stays at the level of generic register layout rather than a shared hand or subject.
